definitions.explanation: Vinegar made from fermented rice, a fundamental seasoning in Japanese cuisine. It has a milder, slightly sweet flavor compared to Western grain or distilled vinegars, making it essential for sushi rice, dressings, and pickles.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧ ('rice') and ⟦{酢|す}→酢：01057_su⟧ ('vinegar'; voiced as ず in compounds). Also sometimes read as ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧ず. The most traditional and widely used vinegar in Japanese cooking.

TYPES:
- ⟦{純|じゅん}→純〜：28361_jun⟧{米酢|こめず}: pure rice vinegar — made from 100% rice; richer flavor
- ⟦{穀物酢|こくもつす}→穀物酢：24495_kokumotsusu⟧: grain vinegar — made from mixed grains; cheaper and sharper
- ⟦{黒酢|くろず}→黒酢：17574_kurozu⟧: black vinegar — aged rice vinegar with a deeper, more complex flavor; popular as a health drink

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {米酢|こめず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use rice vinegar
- {米酢|こめず}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to season with rice vinegar
- {米酢|こめず}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧: rice vinegar, sugar, and salt (the classic sushi rice seasoning trio)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{穀物酢|こくもつす}→穀物酢：24495_kokumotsusu⟧: grain vinegar — made from a blend of grains; a cheaper, more pungent all-purpose vinegar
- ⟦{黒酢|くろず}→黒酢：17574_kurozu⟧: black vinegar — a dark, aged rice vinegar with a mellow, rich flavor
- ⟦{酢|す}→酢：01057_su⟧: vinegar — the general term for all types of vinegar
- ⟦{寿司酢|すしず}→寿司酢：24484_sushizu⟧: sushi vinegar — pre-mixed seasoned vinegar specifically for sushi rice, containing sugar and salt
